title: LuckRead Report and Appeal API Contract
purpose: Production contract for user reports and appeal submission. This contract is subordinate to the canonical OpenAPI document and moderation-operation policy.
invariants: actorId MUST be derived from the authenticated server-side principal and MUST NOT be accepted from the request body.
report target, reason and evidence MUST be validated against the target resource and caller authorization scope before creation.
A report MUST NOT expose reporter identity to unauthorized users or the reported party.
Repeated equivalent reports from the same actor against the same target within the configured deduplication window MUST converge to one authoritative report or an explicit duplicate result.
Report creation MUST NOT directly mutate moderation decisions; moderation state is authoritative only through the moderation workflow.
An appeal MUST reference an eligible moderation decision and MUST be rejected when the decision is not appealable or the actor lacks ownership/scope.
Appeal submission MUST be idempotent and MUST NOT create duplicate active appeals for the same decision and appellant.
Report and appeal mutations MUST emit bounded asynchronous domain events after the authoritative write.
Sensitive report and appeal records MUST use private authorization and MUST NOT be placed in shared caches.
All report and appeal mutations MUST create immutable audit evidence with actor, target, policy/version and correlation identifiers.
